vectors.name: device_info_ack_pa2
vectors.description: Node -> controller: ArtRdm from Port-Address 2 carrying the GET_RESPONSE ACK for DEVICE_INFO from tube 7FF0:00000001 to 7FF0:80123456 (TN 5); FifoAvail 3, FifoMax 4
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtRdm packet definition p.92-93; RDM frame per protocol/rdm-digest.md section 1 (ANSI E1.20), DEVICE_INFO layout as RDM_GET_DEVICE_INFO.json
vectors.notes: RdmPacket = E1.20 frame without start code 0xCC (44 bytes). Message Length 43 = 24 + PDL 19 and the checksum (sum of all bytes incl. 0xCC, mod 2^16) still count the omitted start code.
